findings.issue: Inaccurate claim: 真 read as ま is not limited to 'few old words' — it is the reading in several common modern words (真面目, 真夏, 真冬, 真上, 真下, 真水), which this wording makes sound archaic.
findings.current: Fica só ま em poucas palavras antigas.
findings.suggested: Fica só ま em um grupo de palavras fixas, como 真夏 (まなつ), 真冬, 真上 e 真面目.

findings.issue: Furigana attribute covers only the kanji part: タクシー代 reads タクシーだい and バス代 reads バスだい. The sibling items in the same list use the full reading (電気代 → でんきだい), so these render as wrong readings for the whole word.
findings.current: <jp reading="だい">タクシー代</jp> … <jp reading="だい">バス代</jp>
findings.suggested: <jp reading="タクシーだい">タクシー代</jp> … <jp reading="バスだい">バス代</jp>

findings.issue: Furigana attribute covers only the kanji, not the whole enclosed span, so it would render 'だい' over the entire word. The same file uses full readings elsewhere (電気代 → でんきだい). バス代 has the identical defect (reading="だい").
findings.current: <jp reading="だい">タクシー代</jp> ... <jp reading="だい">バス代</jp>
findings.suggested: <jp reading="タクシーだい">タクシー代</jp> ... <jp reading="バスだい">バス代</jp>

findings.issue: Inaccurate claim: the plain ま reading is not restricted to 'old words'. It appears in common everyday vocabulary (真夏 まなつ, 真冬 まふゆ, 真上 まうえ, 真下 ました, 真夜中 まよなか).
findings.current: Fica só まem poucas palavras antigas.
findings.suggested: Fica só ま em algumas palavras comuns, como 真夏 (まなつ, pleno verão) e 真上 (まうえ, bem em cima).

findings.issue: Misleading politeness claim: the polite counterpart of 悪くなった is 悪くなりました, not '悪くなったです'. Saying the casual form 'doesn't take です' suggests the ungrammatical 〜たです to the learner; the relevant contrast is ます/ました.
findings.current: Por ser casual, não leva です no fim: 急に ('de repente') + 天気が ('o tempo') + 悪くなった ('piorou', forma simples passada).
findings.suggested: Por ser casual, o verbo fica na forma simples (悪くなった) em vez da polida 悪くなりました: 急に + 天気が + 悪くなった.
